lead_lifecycle.promotion_logic: Correlate multiple breadcrumbs about the same institution/project. Funding or planning alone creates a Signal; confirmed design appointments and explicit visitor-experience scope raise confidence; market engagement becomes Expected/Pre-market; only an official procurement notice can become Live Tender.
negative_terms: generic AV supply without exhibition context
